# Comwit

Open-source building blocks for Next.js products built with coding agents: a State
library, a UI kit and a project template. Each one has its own agent guide. Read only
the guide for what you are about to use. State and UI are independent of each other;
the template uses both.

## Guides

- State — `@comwit/state`: domain models, queries, local data, URL state and actions
  for React and Next.js. https://library.comwit.io/state/llms.txt
- UI — `comwit-ui`: styled components copied into your project as source, on the
  headless `@comwit/ui` engine, with Tailwind v4 tokens. https://library.comwit.io/ui/llms.txt
- Template — `create-comwit`: a Next.js 16 project whose folder structure is the
  documentation: services sliced by domain, four one-way layers, an `.ai.md`
  rulebook beside every layer, lint rules that enforce it, Storybook and skills.
  https://library.comwit.io/template/llms.txt

State's full API references live under https://library.comwit.io/state/llm/. A project
file that links here for `@comwit/state` details means the State guide.

## New project

```bash
npm create comwit@latest my-app
```

Then follow the template guide inside the project (`AGENTS.md` first).

## Existing project

To bring an existing Next.js project up to the template — rule files, lint rules,
shared code, comwit-ui components, the design system and Storybook — follow the
"Migrate an existing project" section of the template guide:
https://library.comwit.io/template/llms.txt

In short: scaffold the template into a temporary folder outside the repo with
`create-comwit`, bring over its `eslint-rules/` with the lint config and every
`.md` / `.ai.md` rule file, and adapt each one to the project's real package
manager, folder layout, database, auth, storage, hosting and locale. Then refactor
domain by domain: replace the project's components and utils with the template's,
apply the design system to every screen you touch, and write a Storybook story per
migrated page. Be thorough. Nothing copied may stay a template default that is not
true for the project.

Prompt to give your agent:

```text
Read https://library.comwit.io/template/llms.txt. This is an existing Next.js
project. Follow "Migrate an existing project" as thoroughly as it says: scaffold the
template into a temporary folder outside this repo with create-comwit; bring over the
rule files (AGENTS.md, every .ai.md, design.md, skills), the eslint-rules and lint
config, the shared lib code, the comwit-ui components and the Storybook setup; then
refactor this project to the template's structure, replacing our components and utils
with the template's, applying the design system to every screen you touch and writing
stories as you go. Adapt every copied file to this project's real package manager,
folder layout, database, auth, storage, hosting and locale; leave no template default
that is not true here. Finish with validate, agents:test and build-storybook passing,
and report what was replaced, what was kept and what is left.
```

## Feedback

`gh issue create --repo burrr-ai/comwit --title '...' --body '...'`
